Which should you choose?

Choose a portable power station if you want plug-and-play backup power for camping, emergencies, or running electronics without complicated wiring.

Choose an inverter if you already have a 12V, 24V, or 48V battery system, or want to convert vehicle battery power into household AC electricity.

One important distinction: a portable power station already contains an inverter, so these aren't completely separate technologies.
